messages:
Aria: Heads-up — proposing to remove the soft-pin for runtime 2.20.0 on the small-model canary during the 22:30 UTC window. Posting quick checklist and rollback gates.

Jun: Any kernel or streaming surface changes in 2.20.0?

Aria: No ABI changes. Main diffs: improved tokenizer-aware attention, changed kv eviction jitter, and a GC tuning tweak that can shift memory transiently.

Ops-Neal: Memory transients worry me. Can we add a mem-slope guard and enable kv.grace during the first 45m?

Aria: Yes — plan enables kv.grace and TTL +15% for hour 1. Rollout: 2% for 15m, 10% for 30m, 40% for 45m, then full. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx>0.6% for 5m OR p99 latency +100ms vs baseline OR mem-slope>7% sustained 10m.

DeployBot: Plan registered: action=soft-unpin runtime=2.20.0 model_group=small-model window=2026-03-26T22:30:00Z traffic_ramp=[2,10,40,100] rollback_triggers=["5xx>0.6%5m","p99>+100ms","mem_slope>7%10m"] runbook=/runbooks/unpin-2-20.md

Jun: SDK check: python-sdk v5 passes; go-sdk v3 shows streaming chunk header mismatch. I'll open a shim PR and tag it blocker for full rollout.

Aria: Good. Run pinlist scan now?

DeployBot: Pinlist scan complete: 6 matches (4 customer agent pins, 2 internal). Soft-exempt applied to customer pins for the window. SEs notified.

Ops-Neal: I'll be on-watch. If auto-rollback fires please page ops and pause the ramp.

Docs-Kim: Drafting release note: "runtime 2.20.0: tokenizer-aware attention; KV eviction jitter; transient GC tuning may increase mem during warmup. go-sdk v3 shim required."

Aria: Final call at 22:00 UTC after preflight. Tagging this thread action:unpin-2-20-canary."
